## Immersion

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1|3|5-6"}
learner <- you

immerse(learner)

understand(everything)
# Error: object 'everything' not found
```

## Listen

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1|3|5"}
hear("gin khao?")

literal_meaning <- "Have you eaten?"

meaning <- connection
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Translate

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1|3-6|8"}
translate("mai pen rai")

# "no problem"
# "it's okay"
# "never mind"
# "don't worry about it"

understand("mai pen rai")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Speak

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1-7|3|4|5|6"}
while (!fluent) {

  speak()
  make_mistakes()
  ask_questions()
  practice()

}
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Notice

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1|3|5"}
sobremesa <- "time together at the table after a meal"

describe_in_english(sobremesa)

name_in_spanish(sobremesa)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## See Differently

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1|3|5-6"}
english <- "I forgot it."

spanish <- "Se me olvidó."

# Same experience.
# Differently structured.
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## A New Language

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1|2|3|4"}
translate("repository")
translate("commit")
translate("relative path")
translate("function")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Practice

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1-6|2|3|4|5"}
repeat {

  try()
  make_mistakes()
  ask_questions()
  try_again()

}
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Eventually...

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1|3"}
# You stop translating.

think_in_reproducibility()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Think

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1-9|3-5|7-9"}
while (solving_problem) {

  if (old_language_works) {
    use(old_language)
  }

  if (new_language_reveals_something) {
    think_differently()
  }

}
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Dream

``` {.r code-line-numbers="1"}
dream(in = "new language")
```
